d: A man with prosopagnosia realises his condition has a unique advantage when he's entangled in a crime scene, turning his struggle into a powerful investigative tool.
When Sathi Babu, a thief, finds a little girl who claims him as her father, his life changes.
A blind man, unable to prevent his lover's kidnapping by a psychopathic killer, becomes determined to rescue her from his deadly grasp.
A tough police officer investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of an influential man, putting his own life, career and family at risk.
Irresponsible Kaththi falls head over heels in love with Parineeta. However, Parineeta's father sets certain preconditions that Kaththi needs to fulfil, in order to wed her.
Shiva's search for the truth behind his estranged sister's death leads him to her mansion, where a mysterious supernatural presence lurks. Can he stop it before it consumes him?
Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.
A police officer goes into hiding to bring up his daughter in a safe environment. However, after her life is threatened by deadly gangsters, he must face his past to protect his daughter.
When 18 children are abducted and found dead, Mark, a police officer, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.
